scenario_summaries.title: Honest Public Goods Baseline (0 Attackers, 120 Honest Donors)

attack_model.description: Zero adversarial accounts; measures baseline social welfare, grassroots funding share, and Gini equality across 12 real Zoo research grant proposals.

scenario_summaries.title: Sybil Identity Splitting (S=2 Fresh Wallets, B=25,000 ZOO, Costless IDs)

attack_model.description: Single whale splits B=25,000 ZOO evenly across S=2 freshly minted 0-ZooRep Sybil wallets from a shared funding cluster targeting a synthetic low-merit shell grant.

scenario_summaries.title: Whale Plutocracy Capture (1 Non-Sybil Whale, 25,000 ZOO on Niche Grant)

attack_model.description: Single wealthy non-Sybil donor contributes 25,000 ZOO (~2.5x total honest community spend) to niche grant-11-carbon-credits, contrasting linear plutocracy against QF and capped mechanisms.

scenario_summaries.title: Negative Regime #1: Strict 50-ZooRep Gate Starves Legitimate Newcomers

attack_model.description: Enforces strict 50-ZooRep Contributor gate (r_min=0.00): blocks S=25 Sybils to 0.00% extraction, but simultaneously starves 40 legitimate brand-new community researchers backing grant-03-citizen-science to 0.00% matching.

scenario_summaries.title: Negative Regime #2: Pairwise/COCM False-Positive Suppression on Tightly Knit Honest Lab

attack_model.description: Zero attackers; 24 legitimate researchers in one co-located conservation lab co-fund grant-09 and grant-10. Structurally resembles a collusion ring, suffering severe false-positive matching suppression under Pairwise QF and Hybrid COCM.
